Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line a pie dish.
Fill with the sliced apples, honey, and cinnamon, and cover with the remaining pastry.
Seal the edges, cut a steam vent, and bake at 190 degrees Celsius for 40 minutes until golden.
Cool for 15 minutes and serve warm.
